layer_3_action.subject: Cool, atmospheric view of a northern coastal delta
features: Winding, sluggish river channels merging into a vast estuary
Towering, dark Taxodiaceous conifers draped with primitive moss
Massive fallen logs and driftwood piles clogging the mudflats
Broad-leafed Platanoid plants forming a dense understory
Low-hanging mist blurring the distant horizon of the seaway
layer_3_action.action: A cool, humid morning in a vast river delta. The air is thick with moisture. The ground is a rich, dark mud strewn with decaying wood and large-leafed prehistoric flora. No grass.

visuals.ground: Saturated dark silt and peat. Large patches of rotting wood and fallen needles. Massive fern fronds and broad-leafed angiosperms dominate. No grass.
visuals.water: Turbid, slow-moving brownish water with swirling eddies and floating botanical debris.
visuals.sky: Pale, overcast steel-grey with soft, diffused light and visible atmospheric haze.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Slick, wet mud, carbonaceous shale fragments, and spongy peat.

negative_prompt: grass, desert, bright sand, palm trees, tropical flowers, bright sun, cacti
